description: This file contains Japanese localization strings for the Select2 library version 4.0.6-rc.1, defining messages displayed during search, loading, and selection.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that results could not be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating how many characters should be removed when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to input more characters when input is shorter than the minimum required.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a search is in progress.
